problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks.  
Packages:  
* Package Alpha: size 39 units  
* Package Bravo: size 68 units  
* Package Charlie: size 40 units  
* Package Delta: size 60 units  
* Package Echo: size 35 units  
* Package Foxtrot: size 67 units  
* Package Golf: size 38 units  
* Package Hotel: size 31 units  
* Package India: size 65 units  
* Package Juliet: size 38 units  
* Package Kilo: size 36 units  
* Package Lima: size 34 units  
* Package Mike: size 34 units  
* Package November: size 68 units  
* Package Oscar: size 37 units  
* Package Papa: size 42 units  
* Package Quebec: size 36 units  
* Package Romeo: size 61 units  
* Package Sierra: size 57 units  
* Package Tango: size 35 units  
* Package Uniform: size 37 units  
* Package Victor: size 60 units  
* Package Whiskey: size 58 units  
* Package X-ray: size 62 units  
* Package Yankee: size 40 units  
* Package Zulu: size 64 units  
* Package Aster: size 36 units  
* Package Dash: size 38 units  

Each truck can carry a maximum load of 100 units. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks possible. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total size in a truck must not exceed its capacity.
